name: onyx
description: Puts NorthWrit first for context retrieval in every Claude Code session

onyx_url.title: NorthWrit URL
onyx_url.description: Your NorthWrit web address without a trailing slash, for example https://cloud.onyx.app

onyx_api_token.title: NorthWrit API token
onyx_api_token.description: A personal access token with the read:search scope

onyx_strict_retrieval.title: Strict retrieval
onyx_strict_retrieval.description: Block other search tools until NorthWrit has been consulted for the current prompt

onyx_prefetch.title: Prefetch results
onyx_prefetch.description: Run a raw NorthWrit search before each prompt and inject the top sections. Adds up to 3 seconds per prompt.
